aha: The shaft has two bends that each roll things left into a dead pocket first. Feed it two stones before any pearl (one per pocket); the third stone, the one by the right pearl, belongs in the small notch on the right, not in the shaft.
deadlocks: Pushing a pearl into the shaft first: it rolls into a pocket and is stuck.
Sending the right-hand stone down the shaft instead of into the notch: one left stone then has nowhere to go. It either blocks the left pearl or rolls all the way down and sits on the gate.
Pushing the right pearl left before the notch is plugged: it falls into the notch.
